items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: it was kind of, I was in that kind of a different clique than the younger guys. ... Red Carey, Perciful, the great pianist that was with him for years, Sonny, Corky, myself

ctx.x: 23. And I go down — or 22. I go down and I’m there and Harry comes in. And the manager introduces me to Harry. And Harry says, “Yes I know who you are, Fred, you were with The Lancers” because word got around you know. And in the back as I’m standing there shaking Harry James’s hand, Venuti comes in from the back of the showroom and he says, “Hey Harry.” And of course Harry says, “Joe, how are you?” And he says, “It’s about time you hired a trumpet player that plays as good as you.” I thought, timing. So now I go…

Corcoran and I have become very close, roommates, and then when Corky’s wife was with them I roomed with Sonny. So Sonny and I were really close. And so it was like Red Carey, Perciful, the great pianist that was with him for years, Sonny, Corky, myself, and it was kind of, I was in that kind of a different clique than the younger guys.
